paper.review_basis: Parsed original article text; existing prepared specification and regression coefficients preserved. Direct PDF downloads were unavailable.

evidence: Printed page 1570: mineral A-horizon calibration, excluding clay above 60%, OM above 8%, and sample densities outside 1.0-1.8 g/cm3.
Printed page 1571, Tables 1-2: mass-based texture and OM inputs, volumetric water outputs, positive kPa tension, normal-density reference and three retention segments.
Printed page 1574: fine matric soil is distinguished from gravel-adjusted bulk soil.
contract_decisions: Sand/clay use fine-earth mass fractions; OM remains mass percent. Laboratory method identifiers remain unspecified rather than inferred.
Predicted water at 0, 33 and 1500 kPa has explicit conditions. Available water is a difference with no single pressure condition.
Normal density is a model reference parameter. The adapter recovers saturation by Equation 6 and uses Equations 11-15 over 0-1500 kPa.
Shared native input validation enforces marginal limits and sand+clay<=1 for curve and fixed-output execution. Nonphysical outputs remain failures.
remaining: Six source helper functions still require measurement-contract migration.
HYBRAS fine-earth target basis, predictor protocols/origins and normal-density applicability remain unbound.
Numerical preflight is not external accuracy, grouped selection or uncertainty qualification.
